name: dev.plugrail/expo2027-mcp
description: Unofficial read-only MCP server for GREEN×EXPO 2027, the 2027 Yokohama horticultural expo.

tools.name: get_event_info
tools.description: Unofficial. Basic facts of International Horticultural Expo 2027, Yokohama (GREEN×EXPO 2027): dates, venue, hours, theme, class, expected attendance.

lang.description: Output language for labels. Supported: ja, en, fr, es, zh-Hant, zh-Hans, ko. Content facts stay in their source language. Default: en.

tools.name: list_ticket_types
tools.description: Unofficial. Admission ticket types and JPY prices (early/regular/night/passes/group discounts). Verify on the official ticket site; prices may change.

lang.description: Output language for labels. Supported: ja, en, fr, es, zh-Hant, zh-Hans, ko. Content facts stay in their source language. Default: en.

tools.name: get_access_options
tools.description: Unofficial. How to get to the venue: 4-station shuttle bus (Sotetsu Seya / Mitsukyo, Tokyu Minami-Machida, JR Yokohama Line Tokaichiba), direct buses, parking (car/motorcycle), park & ride, bicycle, walking. Optional filter, e.g. "瀬谷", "shuttle", "parking", "bicycle".

lang.description: Output language for labels. Supported: ja, en, fr, es, zh-Hant, zh-Hans, ko. Content facts stay in their source language. Default: en.

from.description: Optional filter for the access mode or station name.

tools.name: list_villages
tools.description: Unofficial. Lists the 12 Village exhibitors and 4 theme commercial venues with organizer, theme and official URL, plus key exhibits (テーマ館「ねっこ」 etc.).

lang.description: Output language for labels. Supported: ja, en, fr, es, zh-Hant, zh-Hans, ko. Content facts stay in their source language. Default: en.

tools.name: get_news
tools.description: Unofficial. Latest news items from the official site (Japanese titles, up to 20). News titles are NOT translated.

lang.description: Output language for labels. Supported: ja, en, fr, es, zh-Hant, zh-Hans, ko. Content facts stay in their source language. Default: en.

tools.name: search_event_topics
tools.description: Unofficial. Keyword search over curated official-site topics (dates, tickets, access, pavilions, FAQ, mascot, etc.). Returns official URLs.

lang.description: Output language for labels. Supported: ja, en, fr, es, zh-Hant, zh-Hans, ko. Content facts stay in their source language. Default: en.
